items.html: You should also understand how every Aba is Hochma — either the Hochma of BON or the Hochma of the Bina of MA — but Ima is always Bina, either the Bina of the Bina of MA, or the Bina of BON. Therefore MA can bind with BON, whether in Aba or in Ima, since all of them are Hochma — this is in Aba, except that the Hochma of BON becomes the female side to the Hochma of the Bina of MA. Or all of them are Binot in Ima, except that the Bina of the Bina of MA becomes the male side to the Bina of BON.
